We do. It’s actually a good question, absolutely. Because the-- that’s how we deploy in large part, and I think Michael Lipetri said it before, proper deployment is critical. So we take a close look at that, and that fluctuates. It fluctuates week by week, sometimes day by day. And you know, we like to say we’re a dynamic Police Department, we are. We shift resources as we see trends changing. But as we’re sitting here right now, if I can give you an answer, just around 50 percent of crime occurs on a moving train, versus another 50 percent off the train.
